div.head: Grið 19.1
div.ab: Biscpas syndan bydelas ⁊ Godes lage lareowas ⁊ hy scylan georne oft ⁊ gelome clypian to Christe ⁊ for eal Christen folc þingian geornlice ⁊ hy scylan bodian ⁊ bysnian georne godcunde ðearfe Christenre þeode.

Biscpas syndan bydelas and Godes lage lareowas and hy scylan georne oft and gelome clypian to Christe, and for eal Christen folc þingian geornlice, and hy scylan bodian and bysnian georne godcunde ðearfe Christenre þeode.

Die Bischöfe sind die Herolde und Lehrer des Gottesgesetzes (und sie sollen eifrig oft und emsig zu Christo rufen und für alles Christliche Volk eifrig fürbitten) und sie sollen Christlichem Volke künden und durch Beispiel eifrig darlegen, was geistlich noth thut.

The bishops are the heralds and teachers of God's law (and they must call eagerly, often and diligently upon Christ and intercede eagerly for all Christian people), and they must proclaim to the Christian people and eagerly show by example what is spiritually needful.

Bishops are the messengers and teachers of God’s law and they must fervently call to Christ often and frequently, and readily intervene on behalf of all Christian people, and they must preach and diligently set an example for the spiritual benefit of the Christian people.

note.seg: Dem Verf. lag wohl eher eine unbekannte Quelle der drei zu o. I 471 zitierten Denkmäler vor als je ein Stück aus den drei
The author probably had before him an unknown source of the three texts cited above at I 471, rather than a piece from each of the three

Nicht ‘zum Nutzen alles Volkes’, weil godcunde nicht dt. fm. Vielmehr vgl. bodian ge bysnian Godes riht oðrum Polity 18 zweimal. 19. 23; dieselbe Reimformel Can. Eadgari 66; Hom. n. Wulfstan 179. 275. 307; þæt (was) God us (dt.) bisnade Ælfred Greg. Cura c. 21; yfel bysnige Ælfric Homil. ed. Thorpe II 48; (ge)bysnian oðrum (þe): ‘anderem (dir) Exempel geben’ Toller

Not ‘for the benefit of all the people’, because godcunde is not dat. fem. Rather cf. bodian ge bysnian Godes riht oðrum Polity 18 twice. 19. 23; the same rhyming formula Can. Eadgari 66; Hom. n. Wulfstan 179. 275. 307; þæt (what) God us (dat.) bisnade Ælfred Greg. Cura c. 21; yfel bysnige Ælfric Homil. ed. Thorpe II 48; (ge)bysnian oðrum (þe): ‘to give an example to another (to thee)’ Toller
